'''Raskar's villa''' was the residence of the retired [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Raskar]], located on a [[Antipose|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Raskar kept the [[Power gem]] there.
